text: being Observations or Memorials of the most remarkable occurrences, as well public as_ private, which happened in London during the last great visitation in 1665.
zh: 是对 1665 年最后一次伟大访问期间发生在伦敦的最引人注目的事件的观察或纪念，无论是公共的还是私人的。
chunks: being Observations or Memorials
of the most remarkable occurrences,
as well public as_ private,
which happened in London
during the last great visitation in 1665.

text: It mattered not from whence it came; but all agreed it was come into Holland again.
zh: 它从哪里来并不重要；重要的是它从哪里来。但所有人都同意它再次进入荷兰。
chunks: It mattered not
from whence it came;
but all agreed it was come
into Holland again.

text: But it seems that the Government had a true account of it, and several councils were held about ways to prevent its coming over; but all was kept very private.
zh: 但政府似乎对此有一个真实的解释，并且召开了几次会议来讨论如何防止它发生；但一切都保密。
chunks: But it seems
that the Government had a true account
of it, and several councils were held
about ways to prevent its coming over;
but all was kept very private.

text: The people showed a great concern at this, and began to be alarmed all over the town, and the more, because in the last week in December 1664 another man died in the same house, and of the same distemper.
zh: 人们对此表现出极大的担忧，全城都开始感到惊慌，而且更严重的是，因为在 1664 年 12 月的最后一周，同一所房子里又有一个人死于同样的瘟疫。
chunks: The people showed a great concern
at this, and began to be alarmed all
over the town, and the more, because in the last week
in December 1664 another man died
in the same house, and of the same distemper.

text: The usual number of burials within the bills of mortality for a week was from about 240 or thereabouts to 300.
chunks: The usual number of burials
within the bills of mortality
for a week was
from about 240
or thereabouts to 300.

text: This alarmed us all again, and terrible apprehensions were among the people, especially the weather being now changed and growing warm, and the summer being at hand.
zh: 这再次让我们所有人感到震惊，人们充满了可怕的忧虑，尤其是现在天气正在变化，变得越来越温暖，夏天即将来临。
chunks: This alarmed us all again,
and terrible apprehensions were among the people,
especially the weather being now changed
and growing warm,
and the summer being at hand.

text: This was the beginning of May, yet the weather was temperate, variable, and cool enough, and people had still some hopes.
zh: 此时已是五月初，天气却温和多变，足够凉爽，人们还抱有一些希望。
chunks: This was the beginning
of May,
yet the weather was temperate, variable,
and cool enough,
and people had still some hopes.

text: So that now all our extenuations abated, and it was no more to be concealed; nay, it quickly appeared that the infection had spread itself beyond all hopes of abatement.
zh: 因此，现在我们所有的借口都减弱了，不再需要隐瞒了。不仅如此，感染很快就出现了蔓延，超出了所有缓解的希望。
chunks: So that now all our extenuations abated,
and it was no more
to be concealed; nay, it quickly appeared
that the infection had spread itself
beyond all hopes of abatement.

text: The next bill was from the 23rd of May to the 30th, when the number of the plague was seventeen.
zh: 下一个法案是从5月23日到30日，当时鼠疫的数量是十七。
chunks: The next bill was
from the 23rd of May
to the 30th,
when the number
of the plague was seventeen.

text: Now there died four within the city, one in Wood Street, one in Fenchurch Street, and two in Crooked Lane.
zh: 现在，城内有四人死亡，一名在伍德街，一名在芬乔奇街，两名在弯曲巷。
chunks: Now there died four
within the city,
one in Wood Street,
one in Fenchurch Street,
and two in Crooked Lane.

text: I lived without Aldgate, about midway between Aldgate Church and Whitechappel Bars, on the left hand or north side of the street; and as the distemper had not reached to that side of the city, our neighbourhood continued very easy.
zh: 我住在没有阿尔德盖特的地方，大约在阿尔德盖特教堂和怀特查佩尔酒吧之间的中间，在街道的左侧或北侧。由于瘟疫还没有蔓延到城市的另一边，我们的社区仍然很平静。
chunks: I lived without Aldgate, about midway between Aldgate Church
and Whitechappel Bars, on the left hand
or north side of the street;
and as the distemper had not reached
to that side of the city, our neighbourhood continued very easy.

text: The first consideration was of great moment to me; my trade was a saddler, and as my dealings were chiefly not by a shop or chance trade, but among the merchants trading to the English colonies in America, so my effects lay very much in the hands of such.
chunks: The first consideration was of great moment to me;
my trade was a saddler, and as my dealings were chiefly not
by a shop or chance trade, but among the merchants trading
to the English colonies in America,
so my effects lay very much in the hands of such.

text: In a word, he was for my retiring into the country, as he resolved to do himself with his family; telling me what he had, it seems, heard abroad, that the best preparation for the plague was to run away from it.
zh: 总而言之，他支持我退休到乡下去，因为他决定自己和家人一起生活。他告诉我，他似乎在国外听说过，应对瘟疫最好的准备就是逃离它。
chunks: In a word, he was for my retiring into the country,
as he resolved to do himself
with his family; telling me what he had,
it seems, heard abroad, that the best preparation
for the plague was to run away from it.

text: Once I resolved to travel on foot with one servant, and, as many did, lie at no inn, but carry a soldier’s tent with us, and so lie in the fields, the weather being very warm, and no danger from taking cold.
chunks: Once I resolved to travel on foot
with one servant, and, as many did,
lie at no inn, but carry a soldier’s tent
with us, and so lie in the fields,
the weather being very warm, and no danger from taking cold.

text: I desired him to let me consider of it but till the next day, and I would resolve: and as I had already prepared everything as well as I could as to MY business, and whom to entrust my affairs with, I had little to do but to resolve.
zh: 我希望他让我考虑一下，但要等到第二天，我才会下定决心：因为我已经为我的生意做好了一切准备，也把我的事务托付给了谁，所以我除了下定决心之外别无他法。
chunks: I desired him to let me consider of it
but till the next day, and I would resolve:
and as I had already prepared everything
as well as I could as to MY business, and whom
to entrust my affairs with, I had little to do but to resolve.

text: I had set the evening wholly apart to consider seriously about it, and was all alone; for already people had, as it were by a general consent, taken up the custom of not going out of doors after sunset; the reasons I shall have occasion to say more of by-and-by.
chunks: I had set the evening wholly apart to consider seriously about it, and was all alone;
for already people had, as it were by a general consent,
taken up the custom of not going
out of doors after sunset; the reasons I shall have occasion
to say more of by-and-by.

text: He shall cover thee with His feathers, and under His wings shalt thou trust: His truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
zh: 他将用他的羽毛覆盖你，你将信赖在他的翅膀下：他的真理将是你的盾牌和圆盾。
chunks: He shall cover thee
with His feathers,
and under His wings shalt thou trust:
His truth shall be thy shield
and buckler.

text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
zh: 千人必倒在你身边，万人必倒在你右边；但它不会靠近你。
chunks: A thousand shall fall
at thy side,
and ten thousand
at thy right hand;
but it shall not come nigh thee.

text: With this resolution I went to bed; and I was further confirmed in it the next day by the woman being taken ill with whom I had intended to entrust my house and all my affairs.
zh: 带着这个决心，我上床睡觉了。第二天，那个女人生病了，我本打算把我的房子和所有事务托付给她，这进一步证实了我的这一点。
chunks: With this resolution I went to bed;
and I was further confirmed in it the next day
by the woman being taken ill
with whom I had intended
to entrust my house and all my affairs.

text: It was now mid-July, and the plague, which had chiefly raged at the other end of the town, and, as I said before, in the parishes of St Giles, St Andrew’s, Holborn, and towards Westminster, began to now come eastward towards the part where I lived.
chunks: It was now mid-July, and the plague,
which had chiefly raged at the other end
of the town, and, as I said before, in the parishes of St Giles,
St Andrew’s, Holborn, and towards Westminster, began to now come eastward
towards the part where I lived.

text: Likewise in the next week, from the 11th of July to the 18th, when the week’s bill was 1761, yet there died no more of the plague, on the whole Southwark side of the water, than sixteen.
zh: 同样，在接下来的一周，从 7 月 11 日到 18 日，当周的账单是 1761 人时，在整个南华克区的水边，死于瘟疫的人数不超过 16 人。
chunks: Likewise in the next week,
from the 11th of July to the 18th,
when the week’s bill was 1761,
yet there died no more of the plague,
on the whole Southwark side of the water, than sixteen.

text: But the city itself began now to be visited too, I mean within the walls; but the number of people there were indeed extremely lessened by so great a multitude having been gone into the country; and even all this month of July they continued to flee, though not in such multitudes as formerly.
chunks: But the city itself began now to be visited too,
I mean within the walls; but the number of people there were indeed extremely lessened
by so great a multitude having been gone
into the country; and even all this month
of July they continued to flee, though not in such multitudes as formerly.

text: The face of London was—now indeed strangely altered: I mean the whole mass of buildings, city, liberties, suburbs, Westminster, Southwark, and altogether; for as to the particular part called the city, or within the walls, that was not yet much infected.
chunks: The face of London was— now indeed strangely altered:
I mean the whole mass
of buildings, city, liberties, suburbs, Westminster, Southwark, and altogether; for as
to the particular part called the city,
or within the walls, that was not yet much infected.

text: London might well be said to be all in tears; the mourners did not go about the streets indeed, for nobody put on black or made a formal dress of mourning for their nearest friends; but the voice of mourners was truly heard in the streets.
zh: 伦敦可以说是泪流满面。事实上，哀悼者并没有走上街头，因为没有人为他们最亲密的朋友穿上黑色衣服或制作正式的哀悼服装。但街道上确实能听到哀悼者的声音。
chunks: London might well be said to be all in tears;
the mourners did not go about the streets indeed,
for nobody put on black or made a formal dress
of mourning for their nearest friends;
but the voice of mourners was truly heard in the streets.

text: One day, being at that part of the town on some special business, curiosity led me to observe things more than usually, and indeed I walked a great way where I had no business.
zh: 有一天，我因某项特殊事务来到镇上，好奇心促使我比平时更多地观察事物，事实上，我在无事可做的地方走了一段很棒的路。
chunks: One day, being at that part of the town
on some special business, curiosity led me
to observe things more than usually,
and indeed I walked a great way
where I had no business.

text: Everybody was at peace; there was no occasion for lawyers; besides, it being in the time of the vacation too, they were generally gone into the country.
chunks: Everybody was at peace;
there was no occasion
for lawyers; besides, it being
in the time of the vacation too,
they were generally gone into the country.

text: It is true a vast many people fled, as I have observed, yet they were chiefly from the west end of the town, and from that we call the heart of the city: that is to say, among the wealthiest of the people, and such people as were unencumbered with trades and business.
chunks: It is true a vast many people fled, as I have observed, yet they were chiefly
from the west end of the town, and from
that we call the heart of the city: that is to say,
among the wealthiest of the people,
and such people as were unencumbered with trades and business.

text: Again, the Court brought with them a great flux of pride, and new fashions.
zh: 宫廷再次带来了巨大的自豪感和新时尚。
chunks: Again,
the Court brought
with them a great flux
of pride,
and new fashions.

text: But I must go back again to the beginning of this surprising time.
zh: 但我必须再次回到这个令人惊讶的时刻的开始。
chunks: But I must go back again
to the beginning of this surprising time.

text: In the first place, a blazing star or comet appeared for several months before the plague, as there did the year after another, a little before the fire.
zh: 首先，一颗炽热的恒星或彗星在瘟疫爆发前几个月就出现了，就像年复一年，在火灾发生前不久一样。
chunks: In the first place,
a blazing star or comet appeared
for several months before the plague,
as there did the year after another,
a little before the fire.

text: I will not be positive whether he said yet forty days or yet a few days.
zh: 我不确定他说的是四十天还是几天。
chunks: I will not be positive whether he said
yet forty days or yet a few days.

text: I met this poor creature several times in the streets, and would have spoken to him, but he would not enter into speech with me or any one else, but held on his dismal cries continually.
zh: 我在街上见过这个可怜的人好几次，本来想和他说话，但他不肯与我或任何其他人说话，而是不断地发出凄惨的叫声。
chunks: I met this poor creature several times
in the streets, and would have spoken to him,
but he would not enter into speech with me
or any one else, but held
on his dismal cries continually.

text: Next to these public things were the dreams of old women, or, I should say, the interpretation of old women upon other people’s dreams; and these put abundance of people even out of their wits.
zh: 除了这些公共事物之外，还有老妇人的梦，或者，我应该说，是老妇人对别人梦的解释。这些甚至让很多人失去了理智。
chunks: Next to these public things were the dreams
of old women, or, I should say, the interpretation
of old women upon other people’s dreams;
and these put abundance of people even
out of their wits.

text: And no wonder, if they who were poring continually at the clouds saw shapes and figures, representations and appearances, which had nothing in them but air, and vapour.
zh: 毫不奇怪，如果那些不断凝视云层的人看到了形状、图形、表征和外观，其中除了空气和水蒸气之外什么也没有。
chunks: And no wonder, if they
who were poring continually
at the clouds saw shapes
and figures, representations and appearances, which had nothing
in them but air, and vapour.

text: She described every part of the figure to the life, showed them the motion and the form, and the poor people came into it so eagerly, and with so much readiness; ‘Yes, I see it all plainly,’ says one; ‘there’s the sword as plain as can be.
chunks: She described every part of the figure to the life,
showed them the motion and the form, and the poor people came
into it so eagerly, and with so much readiness; ‘Yes,
I see it all plainly, ’ says one;
‘there’s the sword as plain as can be.

text: One saw one thing, and one another.
zh: 人们看到一件事，又看到另一件事。
chunks: One saw one thing,
and one another.

text: The woman endeavoured to show it me, but could not make me confess that I saw it, which, indeed, if I had I must have lied.
zh: 那个女人试图让我看它，但无法让我承认我看到了它，事实上，如果我承认的话，我一定是撒谎了。
chunks: The woman endeavoured
to show it me,
but could not make me confess
that I saw it, which, indeed,
if I had I must have lied.

text: The people about her seemed disgusted as well as she; and I found there was no persuading them that I did not laugh at them, and that I should be rather mobbed by them than be able to undeceive them.
zh: 她周围的人似乎也和她一样感到厌恶。我发现我无法说服他们相信我没有嘲笑他们，而且我宁愿被他们围攻也无法欺骗他们。
chunks: The people about her seemed disgusted as well as she;
and I found there was no persuading them
that I did not laugh at them,
and that I should be rather mobbed
by them than be able to undeceive them.

text: He described the shape, the posture, and the movement of it so exactly that it was the greatest matter of amazement to him in the world that everybody did not see it as well as he.
zh: 他把它的形状、姿势和动作描述得如此准确，这对他来说是世界上最令人惊奇的事情，以至于每个人都没有像他那样看得清楚。
chunks: He described the shape, the posture, and the movement
of it so exactly that it was the greatest matter
of amazement to him in the world
that everybody did not see it
as well as he.

text: These things serve to show how far the people were really overcome with delusions; and as they had a notion of the approach of a visitation, all their predictions ran upon a most dreadful plague, which should lay the whole city, and even the kingdom, waste, and should destroy almost all the nation, both man and beast.
chunks: These things serve to show how far the people were really overcome
with delusions; and as they had a notion of the approach of a visitation,
all their predictions ran upon a most dreadful plague,
which should lay the whole city, and even the kingdom, waste,
and should destroy almost all the nation, both man and beast.

text: It was, indeed, a time of very unhappy breaches among us in matters of religion.
zh: 事实上，我们之间在宗教问题上发生了非常令人不快的冲突。
chunks: It was, indeed,
a time
of very unhappy breaches
among us in matters
of religion.

text: And even those that were, the Government did not allow, but endeavoured to suppress them and shut up their meetings.
zh: 即使是这样，政府也不允许，而是极力镇压他们并关闭他们的会议。
chunks: And even those that were,
the Government did not allow,
but endeavoured
to suppress them
and shut up their meetings.

text: With what blind, absurd, and ridiculous stuff these oracles of the devil pleased and satisfied the people I really know not, but certain it is that innumerable attendants crowded about their doors every day.
zh: 这些魔鬼的神谕以多么盲目、荒唐和可笑的东西取悦和满足了我真正不认识的人，但可以肯定的是，每天有无数的侍从挤在他们的门前。
chunks: With what blind, absurd, and ridiculous stuff these oracles
of the devil pleased
and satisfied the people I really know not,
but certain it is that innumerable attendants crowded
about their doors every day.

text: One mischief was, that if the poor people asked these mock astrologers whether there would be a plague or no, they all agreed in general to answer ‘Yes’, for that kept up their trade.
zh: 一个恶作剧是，如果穷人问这些假占星家是否会发生瘟疫，他们都会普遍同意回答“是”，因为这可以维持他们的贸易。
chunks: One mischief was,
that if the poor people asked these mock astrologers whether there would be a plague
or no, they all agreed
in general to answer ‘Yes’,
for that kept up their trade.

text: But they always talked to them of such-and-such influences of the stars, of the conjunctions of such-and-such planets, which must necessarily bring sickness and distempers, and consequently the plague.
zh: 但他们总是跟他们谈论星星的某某影响，某某行星的合相，这些必然会带来疾病和瘟疫，从而带来瘟疫。
chunks: But they always talked
to them of such-and-such influences
of the stars, of the conjunctions
of such-and-such planets, which must necessarily bring sickness
and distempers, and consequently the plague.

text: But it was impossible to make any impression upon the middling people and the working labouring poor.
zh: 但它不可能给中产阶级和劳动穷人留下任何印象。
chunks: But it was impossible
to make any impression upon the middling people and the working labouring poor.

text: Maid-servants especially, and men-servants, were the chief of their customers, and their question generally was, after the first demand of ‘Will there be a plague?
zh: 尤其是女仆和男仆，他们的顾客最多，他们的问题通常是，在第一次询问“会发生瘟疫吗？”之后。
chunks: Maid-servants especially, and men-servants,
were the chief of their customers,
and their question generally was,
after the first demand
of ‘Will there be a plague?

text: Will she stay here, or will she go into the country?
zh: 她会留在这里，还是回乡下？
chunks: Will she stay here,
or will she go
into the country?

text: And the like of menservants.
zh: 又如婢女之类。
chunks: And the like
of menservants.

text: But I must also not forget that the more serious part of the inhabitants behaved after another manner.
zh: 但我也不能忘记，居民中比较严肃的部分却表现出另一种方式。
chunks: But I must also not forget
that the more serious part of the inhabitants behaved after another manner.

text: So that, in a word, those people who were really serious and religious applied themselves in a truly Christian manner to the proper work of repentance and humiliation, as a Christian people ought to do.
zh: 因此，总而言之，那些真正严肃、虔诚的人以真正基督教的方式致力于悔改和谦卑的正确工作，就像基督徒应该做的那样。
chunks: So that, in a word,
those people who were really serious
and religious applied themselves in a truly Christian manner
to the proper work of repentance and humiliation,
as a Christian people ought to do.

text: Death was before their eyes, and everybody began to think of their graves, not of mirth and diversions.
zh: 死亡就在他们眼前，每个人都开始想到自己的坟墓，而不是欢乐和消遣。
chunks: Death was before their eyes,
and everybody began to think
of their graves,
not of mirth
and diversions.

text: Exact regulations for the conduct of the body in case of an infection.
zh: 感染时身体行为的确切规定。
chunks: Exact regulations
for the conduct of the body in case of an infection.

text: An universal remedy for the plague.
zh: 治疗鼠疫的万能疗法。
chunks: An universal remedy
for the plague.

text: Others set up bills to summon people to their lodgings for directions and advice in the case of infection.
zh: 其他人则制定法案，在感染的情况下召集人们到他们的住所寻求指示和建议。
chunks: Others set up bills
to summon people
to their lodgings
for directions and advice
in the case of infection.

text: An ancient gentlewoman, having practised with great success in the late plague in this city, anno 1636, gives her advice only to the female sex.
zh: 一位古代贵妇人在 1636 年的瘟疫晚期在这座城市取得了巨大成功，她只向女性提供建议。
chunks: An ancient gentlewoman, having practised
with great success in the late plague
in this city, anno 1636,
gives her advice only
to the female sex.

text: An experienced physician, who has long studied the doctrine of antidotes against all sorts of poison and infection, has, after forty years’ practice, arrived to such skill as may, with God’s blessing, direct persons how to prevent their being touched by any contagious distemper whatsoever.
chunks: An experienced physician, who has long studied the doctrine
of antidotes against all sorts of poison and infection, has,
after forty years’ practice, arrived to such skill
as may, with God’s blessing, direct persons
how to prevent their being touched by any contagious distemper whatsoever.

text: I cannot omit a subtility of one of those quack operators, with which he gulled the poor people to crowd about him, but did nothing for them without money.
zh: 我不能忽视其中一个江湖骗子的狡猾，他用这种手段欺骗穷人，让他们围在他身边，但没有钱就什么也不为他们做。
chunks: I cannot omit a subtility
of one of those quack operators,
with which he gulled the poor people
to crowd about him, but did nothing
for them without money.

text: Abundance of poor people came to him accordingly, to whom he made a great many fine speeches, examined them of the state of their health and of the constitution of their bodies, and told them many good things for them to do, which were of no great moment.
chunks: Abundance of poor people came to him accordingly,
to whom he made a great many fine speeches,
examined them of the state of their health and of the constitution
of their bodies, and told them many good things
for them to do, which were of no great moment.

text: But, sir,’ says one poor woman, ‘I am a poor almswoman and am kept by the parish, and your bills say you give the poor your help for nothing.
zh: 但是，先生，”一位贫穷的妇女说道，“我是一名贫穷的施舍女，由教区保管，而您的账单上写着您免费为穷人提供帮助。
chunks: But, sir, ’ says one poor woman,
‘I am a poor almswoman
and am kept by the parish,
and your bills say you give the poor your help
for nothing.

text: I give my advice to the poor for nothing, but not my physic.
zh: 我免费向穷人提供建议，但不提供我的医疗服务。
